events.name: NWTF Film Festival
events.info: From conservation efforts on Americas public lands to the subtle moments that define our hunting heritage, the life-changing power of the outdoors will be on full display at The Refinery May 22, 2027. The National Wild Turkey Federation is hosting its inaugural NWTF Wild Turkey Film Fest. Come enjoy a day of films, live music, exhibitors, food trucks and an overall friendly atmosphere celebrating conservation and the soul of the American hunter. More info Please visit: filmfestival.nwtf.orgAll tickets include a NWTF Membership. General Admission will give you access to shop vendor booths, participate in live auction and drawings. There are several food trucks, restaurant, bars and bathrooms available throughout the main area of the property (ground level). VIP Single allows you to elevate your film festival experience with a single seat that offers premium viewing of the films and music performances. This experience includes buffet-style dinner, two (2) complimentary drink tickets, VIP Gift, access to a VIP only raffle, dedicated bar and bathrooms. PLUS, access to all General Admission amenities. VIP Table allows you to elevate your film festival experience with one (1) dedicated table for eight (8) with premium viewing of the films and music performances. This experience includes buffet-style dinner, two (2) drink tickets/guest, a premium Table gift and 8 individual gifts, access to a VIP only raffle, dedicated bar and bathroom. PLUS, access to all General Admission amenities.(Ticketweb table moniker will not be your table letter at the event. You will be shown to your table when you arrive).All tickets purchased are processed by Ticketweb and are subject to fees. You will receive confirmation of purchase upon completion of payment. Actual tickets will be sent 36-48 hours in advance from Ticketweb directly. Please go to https://www.therefinerychs.com/faq to learn more through their FAQs or email information@therefinerychs.com.
events.pleaseNote: All ticket sales are final. The Refinery is an outdoor venue open rain or shine. Please prepare accordingly.
